description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/SearchProduct/getMissingListings. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns marketplace/channel listings detected as missing during periodic synchronization, together with existing hidden HGR products that can be recovered. ownerAgent: listings. Domain: listings. Entity: missing_listing. Operation: list_missing. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use when the user asks which products from the current store can be imported or recovered into HGR. Input: Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. No body. Output: Returns both collections together: Listings contains ChannelItem, ChannelTitle, Sku and variation attributes; RecoverableListings contains ListingId, PrimaryId and Title. Listings excludes already active products and every recoverable PrimaryId, including all its variations. Search terms: searchproduct getmissinglistings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

name: hgr_get_searchproduct_getmissinglistings
title: Get Searchproduct Getmissinglistings
